body_text:
The determinant is the unique alternating multilinear function
of the columns of a square matrix that takes value $1$ on the
identity matrix. It satisfies $\det(AB)=\det(A)\det(B)$, and a
matrix is invertible exactly when its determinant is nonzero.
This characterization is basis-independent for the associated
endomorphism.
